jobs.occupation: Ergotherapist (Occupational Therapist) – Germany International Applicants Welcome (Ergotherapeut/in)
jobs.description: We are looking for motivated and compassionate Ergotherapists (Occupational Therapists) from abroad who are interested in building their professional careers in Germany. This is an excellent opportunity for qualified professionals who are willing to relocate to Germany and work in a modern healthcare environment.Successful candidates will support patients in improving their independence, mobility, motor skills, cognitive abilities, and quality of life through individualized therapeutic interventions.International applicants are welcome to apply. Guidance regarding professional recognition, German language learning, visa procedures, and relocation may be provided, depending on the employer's arrangements.Key Responsibilities- Assess patients' physical, cognitive, psychological, and functional abilities.- Develop and implement individualized treatment plans.- Provide therapeutic interventions to improve daily living skills and independence.- Support patients recovering from injuries, illnesses, neurological conditions, or developmental challenges.- Monitor treatment progress and document therapeutic outcomes.- Collaborate with physicians, nurses, physiotherapists, and other healthcare professionals.- Educate patients and their families on therapeutic exercises and everyday activities.- Maintain accurate patient records and comply with German healthcare standards.Requirements- Completed qualification or degree in Ergotherapy/Occupational Therapy from an accredited institution.- Relevant professional experience is an advantage; motivated recent graduates may also be considered.- Willingness to relocate to Germany.- Willingness to learn German and achieve the language level required for professional recognition and employment.- Motivation to complete the professional recognition process in Germany.- Strong communication skills, empathy, patience, and a patient-focused approach.- Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.Opportunities for International ApplicantsDepending on the employer and individual circumstances, support may include:- Guidance with recognition of foreign professional qualifications.- Assistance with German language courses.- Information and support regarding visa and work permit procedures.- Relocation guidance and help with settling in Germany.- Assistance with accommodation arrangements, where available.- Opportunities for long-term professional development.What We Offer- Employment opportunities in Germany's healthcare sector.- A professional and supportive working environment.- Opportunities to develop clinical skills and gain international work experience.- Competitive salary based on qualifications, experience, location, and employer.- Potential long-term career opportunities in Germany.How to ApplyInterested candidates should submit:- An updated CV in English or German.- Copies of educational certificates and professional qualifications.- Evidence of relevant work experience, if available.- German language certificates, if available.- Information about current country of residence and willingness to relocate.Take the next step in your career and start your journey as an Ergotherapist in Germany!International candidates are encouraged to apply. jobs.occupation: Senior Partner Development Manager – Distribution Partners Germany, EMEA Partner Organization (Betriebswirt/in - allgemeine Betriebswirtschaft)

jobs.description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced Distribution Partner Development Manager to own and drive the AWS distribution strategy across Germany. In this role, you will manage and grow strategic relationships with our Authorised Distribution Partners such as Ingram Micro and TD Synnex, particularly for SMB and Enterprise customers. An additional area of responsibility is to grow the business with large value added resellers (“Systemhäuser”, e.g. Bechtle, Cancom) across Enterprise and Public Sector Accounts.The AWS Distribution Program enables our distributors to act as force multipliers — leveraging their deep partner relationships, market knowledge, and specialised expertise to extend the reach of AWS solutions to customers we cannot efficiently serve through direct channels alone. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that requires a rare blend of strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and operational discipline. You will not only execute on strategy — you will shape it, acting as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions and influencing worldwide policy decisions where distribution-specific considerations are required.As the single-threaded owner of the German distribution channel, you will serve as the primary interface between AWS and our distributors, driving incremental revenue through their reseller communities. You will work cross-functionally with AWS sales, partner, marketing, and solutions architecture teams to accelerate cloud adoption at scale, particularly within the SMB Commercial Sector.Key job responsibilitiesPartner Management & Strategy• Own end-to-end relationships with Authorised Distribution and Systemhaus Partners in Germany.• Develop and execute joint business plans aligned to AWS go-to-market and EMEA strategy.• Drive QBRs and cadence meetings with partner leadership at VP/CXO level.• Grow distributor-attributed and AWS Marketplace revenue YoY.• Pursue new routes-to-market and "Power of Three" collaboration.Revenue & Performance Management• Own revenue targets for the German channel, including resell and influenced revenue.• Monitor distributor performance: revenue, recruitment, enablement, pipeline.• Produce monthly partner reports from internal dashboards.• Analyse trends, flag risks/opportunities, drive action plans.• Track Partner Attributed Revenue and ensure accurate attribution.Program Design & Execution• Act as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions, representing field-level feedback on attribution models, incentive structures, and partner programs..• Ensure distributors are enabled on launches and policy changes.Enablement & Ecosystem Growth• Recruit, onboard, and activate new resellers into the channel.• Align with PDMs and Account Managers across direct, distribution, and "Power of Three" motions.• Drive technical enablement (AI, Migration, Data & Analytics); support co-sell/co-marketing.Cross-Functional Collaboration• Align Germany execution with EMEA Scale & Distribution strategy.• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Partner Solutions Architects, Operations.About the teamThe Distribution team sits within the Amazon Partner Organisation in Germany & Europe Central, focused on extending AWS's reach through established distributor communities to serve the Commercial Sector at scale. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-performing team that values customer obsession, partner obsession, and execution excellence.Basic Qualifications- Bachelor's degree- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences- Minimum 6 years of channel experience, with specific distribution, indirect channel or reselling background- German and English business fluent- Cloud and/or digital transformation experience — understanding of cloud business models, consumption economics, and partner ecosystems- Proven ability to manage breadth over depth — portfolio management across 30+ partners through leverage and prioritisation- Strong commercial acumen: pipeline management, forecasting, and revenue accountability- Demonstrated stakeholder management across complex, matrixed organisationsPreferred Qualifications- Direct experience with IT distribution (Ingram Micro, TD SYNNEX, Arrow, ALSO) or Systemhaus channel (Bechtle, Cancom, Computacenter)- AWS or hyperscaler partner programme experience- Experience with CRM systems and pipeline analytics (Salesforce preferred)- Understanding of software marketplace transaction models and cloud procurement- Track record of building new coverage models or channel motions from scratch- Familiarity with German SMB and mid-market IT landscapeAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. jobs.occupation: Earth Observation (EO) & Remote Sensing Engineer (m/f/d) (Data Scientist)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Remote Sensing Specialists; Data Scientists; PhysicistsStellenbeschreibung:Earth Observation (EO) & Remote Sensing Engineer (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Remote Sensing Specialists, Data Scientists, Physicists, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS develops AI-supported spatial resilience and geospatial data models for the energy transition. To breathe dynamic life into our static infrastructure data, we integrate global earth observation data into our central inference engine. In this role, you will add the dimension of real-time surface activity and physical states to our spatial intelligence models. Your Focus & Responsibilities - Satellite Pipelines: Build automated pipelines to fetch and process Sentinel-1 (Radar/InSAR) and Sentinel-2 (Multispectral) data via the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem. - Algorithm Development: Develop algorithms to automatically detect surface changes, vegetation decline, moisture indices (NDVI/NDWI), and thermal anomalies. - Data Integration: Seamlessly integrate derived raster metadata and Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs (COG) into our central PostGIS vector database. What We Are Looking For - Technical Background: Degree in Remote Sensing, Geoinformatics, Data Science, Physics, or equivalent practical industry experience.  - Core Technical Skills: Deep practical experience in processing satellite data (Landsat, Sentinel) using Python libraries such as Rasterio, xarray, or GDAL. - Mindset: An analytical mindset capable of deriving tangible ecological, thermal, and structural factors from raw pixel values. - Eligibility: Open to local applicants and international candidates (Chancenkarte / Opportunity Card supported).  - Languages: Professional working proficiency in English (required); German language skills are a plus.  What We Offer - Full-Time Permanent Employment: Long-term career stability with clear growth trajectories.  - Dual Master / Trainee Track Available: Tailored tracks including academic coordination and complete tuition support.  - Accommodation & Onboarding Package: Structured assistance with local accommodation, official registration, and comprehensive onboarding.  - Visa & Administrative Backing: Dedicated employer support for Opportunity Card conversions and visa applications.  - Modern Tech Environment: Work in a high-efficiency environment focused on cutting-edge geospatial intelligence.  How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail:  jobs-geo@iris-institut.org (Subject: Application - Earth Observation Engineer)

jobs.occupation: Data Mining & OSINT Automation Specialist (m/f/d) (Data Engineer)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Software Engineers; Web Scrapers; OSINT SpecialistsStellenbeschreibung:Data Mining & OSINT Automation Specialist (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Software Engineers, Web Scrapers, OSINT Specialists, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS is an applied research and technology initiative dedicated to automated spatial data analysis, infrastructure mapping, and open-source data modeling. Because not all valuable data exists as clean spatial polygons, we build systems that extract hidden knowledge from texts, complex web registries, and unstructured documents.
